d significantly, and will be even** 

- **reversed in the next 10 years.** 

- **Stainless Steel Scrap will always be competitively priced** 

- **and all available scrap will be used (different from primary Ni)**  **The market for primary metal could decline after 2030, as scrap availability will surpass stainless steel production** 

- **The situation is more severe for Ni and Cr than for Moly** 

- **Ni, Cr and Mo mines and smelters who come on-stream** 

- **after 2020 will only enjoy a healthy market for ~10 years**
